brief: A single hex base, nothing else added beside or on top of it, with five drawers in it.

requirements.requirement: Single hex base, nothing else added beside or on top of it
requirements.evidence: Build contains only piece:0,0,0;half-s (Hex base · South half) at 0,0,0 level 0. No other bases beside or on top; check_build shows only that piece plus drawer.

requirements.requirement: Five drawers in that single base
requirements.evidence: Configurator offers at most 1 drawer socket on a half base (tested half-n gave s slot, half-s gave n slot) and 0 on a full base (no drawer/notch/bay sockets). Even stacking two halves vertically only gave 2 drawers total. Five drawers in a single level-0 cell is not offered and cannot be placed without violating placement rules.

finish.summary: Build is a single half-hex base (half-s) at 0,0,0 with one cut-face drawer (drawer:0#0,0#cut), meshClash clear. Five drawers in one base is impossible: full bases offer 0 drawer sockets, half bases offer 1. No way to reach five without adding additional bases beside or on top, which would violate the single-base isolation requirement.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

parts.name: Blank plug
parts.use: Fills an insert recess you are not using, so the face reads flat and the pocket stays clean.

parts.name: Female socket
parts.use: Seats in a recess and takes a stud, which makes it the bottom of every stacked insert.

parts.name: Male stud
parts.use: Threads through a seated socket and stands proud of the face, so it can carry whatever mounts above it.

parts.name: Foot
parts.use: Snaps onto a stud to give the face something to stand on, so a cell can rest on its cover rather than on its rim.

parts.name: Zip-tie anchor
parts.use: Seats in a recess and gives a cable tie something to pass through, so a bundle is anchored to the face instead of looped around it.

parts.name: Trinity handle
parts.use: Reaches across a whole triangle of studs, so a lift is shared between recesses instead of hanging off one, and the cell can be carried loaded.
